faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about SHEGA subscriptions.

items.question: How does the free trial work?
items.answer: Every new account receives a 7-day Premium trial with full access to all features. No credit card or payment information is required. Simply download the app, create your business, and start exploring immediately.

items.question: What happens after my trial ends?
items.answer: After your 7-day trial, you will need to choose a subscription plan to continue using SHEGA. Your data remains safe and secure. Simply select a plan, complete the Telebirr payment, and submit your transaction ID to activate your subscription.

items.question: Can I upgrade later?
items.answer: Yes, you can upgrade from Basic to Premium at any time. When you upgrade, you immediately get access to all Premium features. The remaining value of your current subscription is applied to your new plan.

items.question: Can I switch between Basic and Premium?
items.answer: Absolutely. You can switch between Basic and Premium plans at any time. Downgrades take effect at the end of your current billing period, while upgrades are applied immediately.

items.question: Will my data be deleted if my subscription expires?
items.answer: No, your data is never deleted. If your subscription expires, your account is temporarily suspended but all your business data remains intact. Once you renew your subscription, everything is restored exactly as you left it.

items.question: How do I pay with Telebirr?
items.answer: Select your desired subscription plan in the app, choose Telebirr as your payment method, complete the payment on your Telebirr app, then enter the transaction ID you received back into SHEGA. Our team verifies the payment and activates your subscription.

items.question: How long does payment verification take?
items.answer: Payment verification typically takes just a few minutes. Our team processes Telebirr transactions promptly during business hours. You will receive a notification as soon as your subscription is activated.

items.question: Can I renew before my subscription expires?
items.answer: Yes, you can renew your subscription at any time before the expiration date. Early renewal extends your subscription from the current expiration date, so you never lose any days. We recommend renewing at least 24 hours before expiry to ensure uninterrupted service.
